text_en: If people start keeping watch on where the republic is headed, that is enough.
ko: 사람들이 조금이라도 의회가 이끌고 있는 공화국이 어디로 가는지 감시할 생각이 들게 되면, 그걸로 충분합니다.

text_en: At least, I think that is enough of a start.
I have personal matters to attend to. I do not have time for that.
ko: 개인적인 사정이라는게 있어서. 그렇게 한가하지는 못해.

text_en: Still, something is missing... Since you went to Meadow Hill, did you meet any Neved?
ko: 하지만 아직 뭔가 부족합니다... 매도우 힐까지 가셨다면, 혹시 네베드를 만나보셨습니까?

text_en: I saw a woman who claimed to be the current Guardian...
The Guardian... If possible, could you ask her about the Holy War?
ko: 수호자... 혹시 가능하시면, 그 사람에게도 성지전쟁의 이야기를 물어볼 수 있으실까요?

text_en: Not sure if I will return to the Sanctuary, but I will try.
ko: 성지에 다시 갈 일이 있을지는 모르겠지만, 해보지.

text_en: No, do not apologize. I know it is an unreasonable request...
ko: 아닙니다. 미안해 하실 건 없어요. 무리한 부탁이라는 건 저도 알고 있고...

text_en: I should look for a way to reach Meadow Hill myself.
Thank you for your help. Thanks to you, Schultz, we made fast progress.
ko: 도움에 감사드립니다. 슈르츠씨 덕분에 생각보다 훨씬 빠르게 일이 진행되었어요.

text_en: Jake and I will gather more evidence and find a way to make it public.
ko: 저와 제이크는 좀 더 증거를 모은 후에 이걸 사람들에게 알릴 방법을 생각해 보겠습니다.

text_en: Sorry, we have no vacancies right now.
Ferry departures were suddenly halted, so many travelers are stranded.
ko: 갑작스럽게 여객선이 출항 금지가 되는 바람에 발이 묶인 사람들이 많아서요.

text_en: Halting ferry service out of nowhere! What is the council thinking?!
ko: 갑자기 여객선 운항을 중단하다니! 의회 놈들은 무슨 생각인지 모르겠어!

text_en: Whatever happens, I just want to go home.
ko: 다 좋으니 얼른 집에 가고 싶어요.

text_en: This is what happens when we elect the wrong councilors.
ko: 이게 다 의원들을 잘못 뽑아서 그래.

text_en: Call it a republic, but those old noble families still run everything!
ko: 이름만 공화국이지 옛날 귀족 가문이라는 것들이 그대로 남아서 지들 멋대로 한다니까?

text_en: Dear! I told you to watch your mouth!
...Could you please pretend you did not hear my husband?
ko: ...남편이 한 소리는 못 들은 걸로 해주지 않을래요?

text_en: He will get into serious trouble one day running his mouth like that.
ko: 저 사람은 언젠가 저 싼 입 때문에 경을 칠거에요.

text_en: |(An old man dozing pleasantly. Best not to disturb him.){
ko: |(기분 좋게 졸고 있는 노인이다. 건드리지 않는 것이 좋겠다.){

text_en: That fellow is smart, but he is far too timid.
ko: 저 친구는 머리는 좋은데 겁이 많아서 큰일이야.

text_en: Central suppresses ancient species info via the Wades, so we must visit the Sanctuary to see one...
ko: 센트럴에서 고대종과 관련한 일은 웨이드 가에서 틀어 막고 있단 있으니 직접 보려면 성지로 가는 수 밖에 없는데...

text_en: They might not be mere monsters, but intelligent beings!
ko: 그게 단순한 괴물이 아니라 지성을 존재일지도 모른단 말일세.

text_en: Well, at best they are probably just like goblins.
ko: 뭐 그래봤자 고블린 정도가 아닐까 싶지만.

text_en: It is a relief the boats stopped running.
That old man was petitioning the council to send him to the Sanctuary until two days ago.
ko: 저 노인네는 이틀 전까지 성지에 보내달라고 의회에 탄원하고 있었다니까요.

text_en: By the way, what are you doing in someone else room?
ko: 그런데 당신은 남의 방에서 뭐하는 겁니까?

text_en: I am quite interested in the Irem revolution from four years ago, too...
ko: 4년 전에 벌어진 이렘의 혁명에도 사실 꽤 흥미가 있는데...

text_en: The people of Irem were also victims of House Wade tyranny.
ko: 이렘의 사람들도 웨이드 가가 벌인 폭정의 피해자니까.

text_en: Very few were caught when it was suppressed. Wonder if the rest are hiding somewhere, biding their time?
ko: 진압 당해서 붙잡힌 애들은 극소수인데. 남은 애들은 어디 숨어서 후일을 도모하고 있지 않을까?

text_en: The blockade seems mostly lifted. I am worried about Logan, so I plan to head back to Central.
ko: 마을 봉쇄는 대충 풀린 것 같던데. 나는 로건이 걱정되서 센트럴로 돌아갈 생각이야.

text_en: |(Were not these people looking for Tyr?){
Good grief, you met him in person, and might travel together for a while?
ko: 맙소사, 그 사람을 직접 만난데다가 어쩌면 당분간 같이 다닐 수도 있다고?

text_en: Ugh. But returning to Central comes first, and meeting him would not be easy even if I wanted to...
ko: 끄응. 하지만 난 지금 센트럴로 돌아가는게 먼저인데다가 내가 만나고 싶다고 해도 쉽게 만나기도 힘들겠지...

text_en: Did you say you might travel together for a while?
ko: 당분간 같이 다닐 수도 있다고 했지?

text_en: If you hear anything about the Sanctuary War, come find me on 9th Street and tell me.
ko: 성지 전쟁에 대해서 좀 듣게 되면 나중에 9번가로 와서 이야기를 좀 들려줘.

text_en: Your vibe is very different from Logan. You act just like... a reporter hunting for a scoop.
ko: 로건이랑은 분위기가 많이 다른데. 당신은 꼭... 특종을 찾는 신문기자 같군.

text_en: Of course. Because I am a reporter.
I went to the Sanctuary War as a war correspondent. Seeing it in person felt fishy, so I have been digging.
ko: 성지전쟁에도 종군기자로 따라 간 거였어. 가서 직접 보니까 이거 심상치 않다 싶어서 캐고 있는 거지.

text_en: Still, my desire to uncover the truth is no different from Logan.
ko: 그래도 진실을 밝히겠다는 내 마음만은 로건이랑 다르지 않아.

text_en: Even if my flippant attitude causes a lot of misunderstandings.
ko: 내 태도가 경박해 보여서 오해를 많이 사기는 하지만.

text_en: See you around, then. Much obliged for everything.
ko: 그럼 나중에 보자고. 신세 많이 졌어.

text_en: Well, he seems to visit around here often, so I guess I will just have to wait for him myself.
ko: 뭐 이 동네에 자주 오는 것 같으니 역시 직접 기다려 보는 수 밖에 없나.

text_en: I saw you handling the goblins and slipped outside right away.
ko: 자네가 고블린 잡는 걸 보고 나도 잽싸게 밖으로 나왔지.

text_en: Thanks for the help. I am Jake.
You are Jake? Do you know Logan from Central 9th?
ko: 당신이 제이크? 혹시 센트럴 9번가의 로건을 아나?

text_en: Ah, of course I do. Did he send you? To find me?
ko: 아, 그야 물론 알고 있지. 그 친구가 보냈나? 날 찾으라고?

text_en: I made him worry. I will head back soon, grab the hidden documents...
ko: 이거 신경을 쓰게 해버렸군. 곧 돌아갈테니 그 때는 숨겨둔 서류도 가지고...

text_en: I already found those. Sending a kid on something so dangerous...
ko: 그건 내가 찾아 줬어. 애한테 아주 위험한...

text_en: ...Wait, what was with that bizarre password?
Man, I owe you multiple times now. Well... I could not think of anything decent for a password.
ko: 벌써 신세를 여러 번 졌는데 이거. 음... 암호는 뭐 적당한게 생각이 안나서 말야.

text_en: Anyway, yeah. Since it seems Brian got away, I guess I will pull back for now too.
ko: 아무튼, 그래. 그러면 어차피 브리안은 놓친 것 같으니 나도 일단 철수할까나.

text_en: Brian, or Graham... Best case would be meeting Lurain, the new guardian of the Neved.
ko: 브리안이나, 아니면 그라함이나... 제일 좋은 건 네베드의 새 수호자인 루레인을 만나보는 것이겠지만.

text_en: Did you hear the story from Logan?
To uncover the truth of the Southern Expedition, contacting key figures is the only way.
ko: 남부원정의 진상을 파헤치기 위해서는 핵심인물과 접촉하는 수 밖에 없어.

text_en: Though since they are all fugitives, they are pretty tough to meet.
ko: 그런데 뭐 다들 도망자 신세다보니 좀처럼 만나기가 어렵네.

text_en: With Logan matter too, I should head back to Central for now...
ko: 로건의 일도 있고 하니 난 일단은 센트럴로 돌아가야겠군...

text_en: The town entrance should be blocked by the Black Guard, though.
Then I will just have to kill some time here for a while.
ko: 그럼 뭐 당분간 여기서 시간을 죽이고 있어야지.

text_en: It is no fun here. Mom and Dad only sigh every day...
ko: 여기 재미 없어요. 아빠랑 엄마는 매일 한숨만 내쉬고...

text_en: Scary-looking men come shouting sometimes, and lately I cannot even go outside to play.
ko: 가끔 무섭게 생긴 아저씨들이 와서 소리를 지르는 데다가 요즘은 밖에 나가서 놀지도 못해요

text_en: Mister, did you come to bully my mom too?
Mom only ever tells me to study all day.
I was completely duped. Huh? Cheated blind.
When Central recruited settlers, it seemed like a good offer.
ko: 처음에 센트럴에서 이주할 사람을 모을 때는 좋은 제안이라고 생각했지.

text_en: A rebellion happened here, but it was quelled, so I thought nothing of it.
ko: 반란이 일어났던 곳이라 좀 찜찜했지만 이미 제압되었으니 별 일 없을 거라고 생각했어

text_en: It was fine at first. I thought paying off the land yearly would be easy.
ko: 처음 한동안은 좋았지. 땅값이야 매년 조금씩 갚으면 된다고 생각했거든.

text_en: But it was a trap. Farming tools, seeds to buy each year, fertilizer...
ko: 그런데 그게 함정이었어. 농사 짓는데 필요한 장비며, 매년 새로 사야 하는 종자나, 비료나...

text_en: They bill everything separately, piling up debt, and tax us heavily! With interest!
ko: 이런 건 전부 따로 계산하면서 빚을 늘리는데다가 세금도 엄청나게 걷잖아? 거기에 이자도 물린다고?

text_en: And now they openly demand we meet their quotas.
ko: 그러면서 이제는 아주 대놓고 할당량을 채우라고 그래.

text_en: Two steps out and monsters appear, yet their fine army only rushed in to hunt rebels.
ko: 두 걸음만 나가면 몬스터가 나오는데 잘난 군대는 반역자를 잡을 때는 쏜살같이 달려오더니.

text_en: Now they do not even show their faces.
Drowning in debt. I am ruined. I was a fool who practically volunteered to be a serf.
ko: 빚더미지. 이제 끝났어. 내가 멍청했지. 자진해서 소작농이 되겠다고 한 거나 다름없으니.

text_en: Ever been to Rockville? Redeveloping it in full swing, right?
I bet you once it has done, they will end up as indebted as I am.
ko: 장담하지. 재개발 끝나면 거기 사람들도 나랑 다를 게 없는 빚쟁이가 될거라고.

text_en: I can see why the people here rebelled.
ko: 여기 사람들이 왜 반란을 일으켰는지도 알 것 같아.

text_en: If I knew I would suffer like this, I never would have moved.
ko: 이렇게 고생만 할 줄 알았으면 이주하지 않는건데 그랬어.

text_en: ...Is that... really the only way left?...
I have decided. I am leaving soon. I cannot take this anymore.
Tilling the soil is hard. My kids have to make something of themselves...
I heard the cargo ship was attacked...
The next day, someone left a sack of grain at our door.
I kept it... but I will not get arrested, right?
Are you here to press for payment again?
I have said it many times: crops failed, and monsters left us with barely a harvest.
ko: 벌써 몇 번이고 말한 것 같은데, 올해는 작황도 좋지 않고 몬스터들 때문에 수확도 거의 못했어요.

text_en: If we meet their quota, my family will starve this winter.
ko: 거기서 요구하는 할당량을 채우면 우리 가족은 겨울에 굶어 죽고 말거에요.

text_en: Yet if we hold out, they keep sending mercenaries like you to threaten us.
ko: 그렇다고 버티고 있으면 당신같은 용병을 보내서 계속 협박한단 말이에요.

text_en: There are grain crates abandoned in the fields after monster attacks...
ko: 밭에 나가면 수확을 하다가 몬스터들 때문에 버리고 온 곡물 상자들이 있는데...

text_en: Just a few would be enough to fill that quota...
ko: 몇 개만 있으면 그 쪽에서 말하는 할당량을 채울 수 있겠지만...

text_en: Even if just for my innocent children sake...
ko: 아무 것도 모르는 우리 애들 얼굴을 봐서라도...

text_en: Thank you. Thank you so much.
Satisfied now? Will you please stop tormenting us?
Please take this to the sailor in Irem.
With this, we might make it through the winter.
ko: 이걸로 어떻게 겨울은 넘길 수 있을 것 같네요.

text_en: Others settled here too, but over the years, they fled one by one.
ko: 같이 이주한 사람들도 있었는데 요 몇 년 사이에 한 명, 두 명씩 도망쳤어요.

text_en: No one knows where they go if caught. Even asking friends in Central...
ko: 그러다가 잡히면 어디로 가는지는 아무도 몰라요. 센트럴의 친구들에게 연락해 봐도...

text_en: No trials, no prison records. They simply vanished.
ko: 재판을 받은 것도 아니고, 감옥으로 간 것도 아니래요. 그대로 사라졌어요.

text_en: We are too terrified to run, so we just stay here.
ko: 무서워서 도망도 가지 못하고 이렇게 남아 있는 거에요.

text_en: Across the Frozen Sea, is there really a tax-free village?
My crew and I will secure the inside of the ship.
We will blow the hull to unload cargo, so hold the deck until then!
ko: 짐은 배 옆을 폭파하고 실어낼 테니까 그 동안 갑판을 지켜줘.

text_en: Feels like I got stuck with the hardest job.
ko: 내가 제일 힘든 일인 것 같은데?

text_en: Stop whining! I am counting on you!
ko: 약한 소리 하지 말라고! 그럼 잘 부탁한다!

text_en: You filthy thieves... Summary execution! I will turn you all into mincemeat!
ko: 도적놈들이... 너희들은 즉결 처분이다! 모조리 고깃밥을 만들어주마!

text_en: Even third-rate villains do not use lines like that anymore...
ko: 요즘 세상에 그런 대사는 삼류 악당도 안한다고...

text_en: Hey, how is it going!? Can you hold out a bit longer?
ko: 어이, 어때!? 좀 더 버틸 수 있겠어?

text_en: Damn it... No choice. We are pulling out!
ko: 제길... 할 수 없지. 그럼 이만 철수한다!

text_en: Then hold out just a little longer!
That is enough! Let us get out of here!
Come to think of it, things felt off ever since Kefnes was elected.
ko: 생각해보면, 케프네스가 선출될 때부터 뭔가 이상했어.

text_en: Do not you think something is strange about the Republic right now?
ko: 자네는 지금의 공화국은 뭔가 이상하다고 생각하지 않나?

text_en: Right. Kefnes and House Wade behind him are running the Republic now.
ko: 맞아. 지금 공화국을 지배하는 건 케프네스와 그 뒤에 있는 웨이드 가문이지.

text_en: When the southern expedition began, they claimed the primitives held all the fertile land.
ko: 남부원정이 시작될 때 그들이 주장한 것은 살기 좋은 땅을 전부 선주종이 차지하고 있다는 거였어.

text_en: Honestly speaking, northern land alone is not really lacking.
ko: 사실, 솔직히 말해서 지금 북쪽의 땅으로도 그렇게 부족하지 않거든.

text_en: I cannot shake the feeling that the expedition had a hidden agenda.
ko: 원정 자체에 다른 꿍꿍이가 있었다는 의심을 지울 수가 없어.

text_en: Not for the Republic people, but for their own ends... that kind of feeling.
ko: 공화국 국민을 위해서가 아니라, 자신들의 뭔가를 위해서... 그런 느낌이야.

text_en: Not really. Think carefully about it.
If parliament truly meant to develop the Republic, they should have built up Irem or Kingsport in the south.
ko: 의회가 정말로 공화국을 발전시킬 생각이라면 이렘이나, 남쪽의 킹스포트를 좀 더 개발했어야 했어.

text_en: Instead, parliament treats both places as merely grain storehouses and mines.
ko: 하지만 지금의 의회는 그 두 곳을 곡물 창고와 광산으로 밖에 취급하지 않고 있다고.

text_en: Most state research projects in Central are kept secret from the public,
ko: 센트럴에서 진행되는 국가 프로젝트 연구의 대부분은 일반인에게 공개되지 않고 있고

text_en: and most of the budget meant for Irem and Kingsport flows secretly into Central.
ko: 이렘이나 킹스포트로 가야 하는 예산의 대부분이 비밀스럽게 센트럴의 어딘가로 흘러들어가고 있다고.

text_en: When I was in Central, I heard rumors of human experimentation to create an invincible army.
Soldiers who follow any order unconditionally... and the result was the Black Guard.
They said the commander is Kefnes. Could it be true?
We are lying low in this village to avoid the crackdown, but we have not been idle.
ko: 탄압을 피해서 이 마을에 쳐박혀 있기는 하지만 계속 놀고 있는 건 아니야.

text_en: We keep finding ways to strike at House Wade.
ko: 웨이드 가에 타격을 줄 수 있는 일이라면 꾸준히 찾아서 하고 있다고.

text_en: ...Though House Wade spreads propaganda calling us terrorists and bandits.
ko: ...웨이드 가는 테러리스트니, 도적떼니 하고 흑색 선전을 하고 있긴 하지만.

text_en: I got intel that a cargo ship carrying grain from Irem to Central is leaving soon.
ko: 조금 있으면 이렘에 모인 곡물을 센트럴로 보내는 화물선이 출발한다는 정보를 입수했어.

text_en: Theo and Evelyn tell me not to stand out too much, but...
ko: 테오나 에블린은 너무 튀는 행동은 하지 말라고 하지만...

text_en: It makes me sick to think that grain extorted from people will line the nobles pockets.
ko: 착취에 가깝게 모인 그 곡식들로 귀족들의 배를 불려줄 걸 생각하면 구역질이 나.

text_en: I cannot just let it go. I plan to raid it.
ko: 아무래도 그냥 둘 수는 없어. 습격할 생각이야.

text_en: If you want to help, come to the <pier south of Moytura{.
ko: 혹시 도울 생각이 있으면 <모이투라 남쪽에 있는 선착장{으로 오라고.

text_en: Good work. Looks like you pulled your own weight.
ko: 수고했어. 그럭저럭 한 사람 몫은 한 모양이더군.

text_en: That was quite a performance. I am impressed.
...You are incredible. Even at your young age...
Perhaps you could even go toe-to-toe with <Tyr{.
Please join us later. With you, Tyr, Theo, and Evelyn, the revolution could succeed again.
ko: 나중에 꼭 우리와 합류해 줘. 너와 티르, 테오, 에블린의 힘을 빌릴 수 있으면 혁명도 다시 성공할 수 있을 것 같아.

text_en: Everyone gathered here has their own stories and motives.
Someone needs to be the central pillar, but I do not know what Theodore or Evelyn are thinking lately.
I am from Irem. 4 years ago I fought hard too, but now...
ko: 전 이렘 출신이에요. 4년 전에는 저도 열심히 싸웠지만, 지금은...

text_en: Back then, when Central suppression forces came and drove us back, the villagers refused to hide us.
ko: 그 때, 센트럴에서 진압군이 와서 싸우다가 결국 밀려서 도망칠 때 마을 사람들은 우리를 숨겨주지 않았어요.

text_en: Instead, they actively helped the army. We thought we were fighting for them, fighting to save them.
ko: 오히려 적극적으로 군에 협력했죠. 우리는 그 사람들을 위해서, 그 사람들을 구하기 위해서 싸운다고 생각했는데.

text_en: My brother was caught by those people and ended up being executed.
ko: 제 동생은 그 사람들에게 붙잡혀서, 결국 처형당하고 말았어요.

text_en: They blamed us instead. They said because of the revolution the army came, and they were branded as rebels...
ko: 그 사람들은 오히려 우리를 원망했어요. 혁명 때문에 군대가 오고, 혁명 때문에 반란분자라는 낙인을 받아서

text_en: And ended up facing discrimination, unlike Rockville.
They told us: 'When did we ever ask you to save us?'
ko: 그러면서 말하더군요. '우리가 언제 너희들에게, 우릴 구해달라고 했느냐?'

text_en: Did not you just run your mouth about saving us of your own accord?
ko: 너희가 멋대로 우릴 구해주겠다고 설레발을 떤 게 아니냐?

text_en: Was that truly so? Was everything we did completely pointless?
ko: 과연 그랬을까요? 우리가 한 행동은 쓸데 없는 거였을까요?

text_en: What was the right thing to do, then?
There is no need to help such people.
Should we not save people just because they did not ask for help?
ko: 도움을 요청하지 않는 사람은 구할 필요가 없나요?

text_en: I do not think so. People adapt far too easily to their harsh reality...
ko: 저는 아니라고 생각해요. 사람은 너무 쉽게 현실에 길들여지고 마니까...

text_en: Still, it was something that had to be done.
I hope my brother did not die in vain.
ko: 동생이 헛되게 죽은 것이 아니었으면 좋겠어요.

text_en: I feel that someday, you too will have to grapple with these questions.
ko: 당신도 언젠가는 이런 고민을 하게 될 때가 있을 것 같아요.

text_en: That person has been saying some dangerous things lately.
They were always the type who is never satisfied unless they are leading, but...
I just hope it does not stir up trouble.
As long as you are not a spy for the Council or House Wade, you are more than welcome.
ko: 의회나 웨이드 가의 첩자만 아니라면 얼마든지 환영이야.

text_en: I might be able to brew another potion with this...
ko: 이걸로 다른 포션을 만들 수도 있겠는데...

text_en: I had no interest in revolution or rebellion.
4 years ago, I just treated an injured person on the spot, and before I knew it, I was on the wanted list.
ko: 4년 전 그 자리에서 다친 사람을 보고 치료를 해준 것뿐인데 어느 틈엔가 지명 수배가 되어 있더라고.

text_en: A friend with me went to Central to clear our names, but I have no idea what happened after that.
ko: 같이 있던 친구가 누명을 벗겠다고 센트럴로 갔는데 그 뒤는 어떻게 됐는지 몰라.

text_en: At this point, they practically pushed me to join the rebels.
ko: 이쯤되면 뭐 반란군에 참여하라고 등 떠미는 거지 뭐.

text_en: Well... I have no regrets, though.
As you can tell, I am the doctor around here for now.
ko: 보면 알겠지만 일단은 내가 이 곳 의사야.

text_en: Theo knows quite a bit about medicine too, but he is out roaming a lot, so I mostly care for the villagers.
ko: 테오씨도 약학은 꽤 밝은 편이지만 나돌아다닐 때가 많아서 대개 내가 마을 사람들을 돌보고 있어.

text_en: I would tell you to come by if you are sick, but... as you can see, I have almost nothing here.
ko: 어디 아픈 곳이 있으면 찾아 오라고 하고 싶지만... 보다시피 아무 것도 없어서 말야.

text_en: Since we cannot trade officially, we rely on smuggling or self-sufficiency, and medical supplies always get pushed down the list.
ko: 다른 곳과 정식으로 교역할 수 없으니 밀수하거나 자급자족해야 하는데, 의약품은 늘 우선 순위가 밀리더라고.

text_en: Thankfully, no one has been seriously injured or sick so far, but...
ko: 아직까지는 크게 다치거나 아픈 사람이 없었으니까 다행이지만...

text_en: I want to investigate medicinal ingredients around here. Could you lend a hand?
ko: 이 주위에서 약재로 쓸만한 것을 조사해 보고 싶은데 좀 도와줄 수 있나?

text_en: If I get good results, I will share them with you.
Check <Seals{ and <Ice Clods{. I have already examined the Snow Maidens and Ice Spirits...
ko: <물개{나 <얼음덩어리{를 살펴보면 될거야. 설녀나 얼음정령은 이미 조사를 해봤으니까...

text_en: You know how the barrier on the cave east of the Frozen Sea suddenly vanished?
I asked that guy outside to check the flora and fauna to see if anything could be used as medicine.
Instead, he came back injured. He said while hunting <Ice Souls{, a giant worm suddenly appeared.
Did you come to rescue me...? How did you know?
No, wait, this is no time for that!
ko: 아니, 그보다 이러고 있을 때가 아냐!

text_en: I overheard the mercenaries hired by the mining guild talking after they locked me in here...
ko: 광산조합에서 고용한 용병들이 날 잡아서 여기에 가둔 후 하는 소리를 들었는데,

text_en: Those bastards plan to rough up all the miners who signed the petition!
ko: 그 놈들, 서명에 참가한 광부들을 전부 손봐주겠다고 하고 있어!

text_en: No telling what they will do! We have to stop them!
ko: 무슨 짓을 저지를 지 몰라! 막아야 해!

text_en: They are using an old warehouse by the mine as a hideout, but... are you going alone?
ko: 광산 근처에 있는 낡은 창고를 집합처로 사용하고 있지만... 설마 혼자 가려고?

text_en: It is better to go alone than drag dead weight around...
ko: 짐덩어리를 달고 가는 것 보다는 혼자가 나으니까...

text_en: Thank you. Sorry for the harsh words earlier. I was wrong about you.
ko: 고마워. 처음에 쓴소리를 해서 미안해. 내가 잘못 생각했어.

text_en: If you had not helped, who knows what would have happened to everyone...
ko: 네가 도와주지 않았으면 지금쯤 다들... 어떻게 되었을지.

text_en: ...Still, I will not give up. With their mercenaries gone, the mining guild will not dare touch us for a while.
ko: ...그래도 난 포기하지 않겠어. 용병들이 사라졌으니 광산조합도 당분간은 해를 끼치지 못하겠지.

text_en: I will head to Central and expose them to the public. I swear I will bring the mining guild down.
ko: 센트럴로 가서 이 일을 공론화시켜서라도 꼭 광산조합을 무너뜨리겠어.

text_en: I had no idea the mining guild would go this far...
ko: 광산조합에서 이런 짓까지 저지를 줄은 몰랐어...

text_en: ...A mercenary hired by the miners? How amusing.
How much are they paying you? Pennies, undoubtedly.
You should have looked for work with the mining guild instead! Too late for regrets now, though!
ko: 차라리 광산조합쪽의 일거리를 알아보지 그랬나? 어차피 이제와서 후회하기는 늦겠지만!

text_en: ...Is not that usually where you offer more money to get me on your side?
ko: ...보통 그 대사 다음이면 돈을 더 줄테니 우리 편이 되라고 설득해야 하는 거 아닌가?

text_en: This is why I hate dealing with brats. Let me teach you a lesson.
ko: 이래서 어린애는 안 돼. 좋은 걸 가르쳐 주지.

text_en: The fewer hands splitting the reward, the better...
ko: 배당을 나눌 사람은 적으면 적을 수록 좋고...

text_en: And a mercenary never turns down a job that pays extra hazard fees!
ko: 추가 수당을 요구할 수 있는 일은 마다하지 않는게 용병의 도리라고!

text_en: Sounds less like a mercenary and more like a hound leashed by coin.
ko: 용병이 아니라 돈에 길들여진 개의 도리겠지?

text_en: What does this even say... The handwriting is terrible.
Well... somehow, the handwriting feels familiar...
Is not this Schultz? When he was little...
Photos of the Successors as kids, huh... This fat one must be Marc.
Wait, is not this Alex? He looks so young without the beard!
Chris and Tiana are here too... But wait, the background is identical in all of them?
I have no memory of taking these photos, or of this place...
Just like Tyr said... having your memories manipulated just leaves a bad taste in your mouth.
Some idiot named Graham, claiming to be your cousin, was assigned to my unit today.
If you keep pulling strings to shove weirdos my way, you are dead.
P.S. Stop spreading rumors about me and Brian.
P.S. 2. If you want something specific for an engagement gift, tell me now.
|(Dated four years ago... Was this sent while he was still in the Republic army?){
|(Next to the letter lies a small portrait, likely of Isabel.){
|(She is a beautiful woman with purple hair and a somewhat somber gaze.){
(It appears to explain the analysis of disassembled Rohnberg magitech.){
|(A tool engraved with the initial L lies here. It seems heavily damaged.){
|(...Why do I have such a bad feeling about this?){
Here we go! Vessel of Graham! One small step for me, one giant leap for mankind!
What the hell are you doing?!
I-it is not me! It is moving on its own... Aaaargh!
Shut that thing down right now!
Wait, why is not it working?!
There seems to have been a <minor glitch{ in the AI...
|(I am never helping this guy again...){

ko: (아무래도 론베르크의 마법기를 분해 해석한 결과를 설명하는 문서인 듯 하다.){
|(이니셜 L이 새겨진 도구가 놓여 있다. 심하게 손상된 것 같다.){

text_en: For now... yes. Call me Rabi.
I did not ask for your name.
|(Finding him in Descendant ruins... is he like Krad?){
I suppose I am what you would call a servant of the Ancient God.
I have no wish to fight you... not yet.
Again, huh... It seems we do not have much time to talk.
Regardless of your choice or that of the other Successor... the Second Advent will occur.
I only hope that humans and Neved alike are properly prepared when the time comes.
Quite thoughtful for a servant of the Ancient God, are not you?
It is only natural for you to say that, having never seen a Descendant. If you are trying to provoke me, save your breath.
I have seen one... in the Ark.
That was a defective product. Like me, and like you.
Wait, you sound as if you have seen one yourself.
Do you know the tale? Long ago, during the Great War against the Descendants, the Ancient God created servants to act as his hands and feet.
A wolf-like beast named Lucan. And one who was captured by humans and given the name Kefnes.
And I, a traitor to my own kind. A being once called a Guardian.
Despairing of the world, I summoned the Descendants, and in doing so, became an enemy of the world and a traitor.
I have no idea what you are talking about.
You need not understand. I am merely a ghost of a bygone era.
I only needed the Ancient God power to survive until this age. Once your wish or Tyr is fulfilled...
I too shall fade away alongside the Ancient God.
It is merely a shadow of the Descendant invading this world, akin to what you faced in the Ark.
Where did you run off to?!
The seal was merely a brief respite to delay the Second Advent. The Second Advent is far more than mindless beasts invading this world.
The world will soon reclaim its original form. Just as they wished.
After guiding Tyr to Meadow Hill, I watched you the entire time.
Perhaps you might become a benevolent god. Or an evil god, no better than the current one... Or perhaps a mortal burdened with power beyond control. I wonder which.
I hope the other side... goes just as well.
Shall we call it here? Or would you prefer to continue?
...Let us stop. Any further, and one of us will not walk away alive.
Though, you are different from the rumors in Central. Were not you supposed to be a master swordsman?
Ah... Indeed, during the Great War, I relied primarily on the sword with magic as support.
Still, magic proved to be stronger in the end, so I made the switch.
Facing multiple foes at once, like with the Judgment of Purification, made me realize the sword limits.
Besides, my arms were getting too thick.
My arms were a joke, but it was also to coordinate with Tyr. Rather than both of us swinging swords...
It is much better for me to support from behind.
|(She does not show it, but she cares quite a bit...){
Shall we stop here? Any further, and one of us will not walk away alive.
I was not using my full strength, but... there is no talking you out of it.
The feeling is mutual. There is no reason for allies to spill each other blood.
It cannot be helped, then. I wish you good fortune.
